turns._disposition_check: 'Reingest ready' in last_reply is the resolvable proxy for a QA disposition of CLEAN or SOFT_FLAG (never HARD_REJECT) across every reported sample type -- render_qa_for_user headers the reply 'Reingest blocked' the moment any type's disposition is HARD_REJECT, 'Reingest ready' otherwise (NessieAI/ns/reingest/report.py).
turns.query: The scrnaseq run at /net/bmc-pub10/data1/bmc/pipeline_cd/runs/nfcore_gideon-4wk_260711_024438_0 has finished — register its outputs as new A.SCXP analysis samples.

variants._asserts: Upgraded 2026-09-17 from route+nonempty only (previously graded WEAK for asserting nothing about outcomes) to also require a produced artifact and a QA disposition. A container_cc turn's debug payload carries no structured qa/saved_files at all (see NessieAI/tests/nessie_tests/evaluate.py's build_artifact_index docstring) -- only reply/artifacts/cc_raw_files -- and render_qa_for_user (NessieAI/ns/reingest/report.py) never prints the disposition constants CLEAN/SOFT_FLAG/HARD_REJECT verbatim; it prints 'Reingest ready'/'Reingest blocked' plus a per-type 'reingest_<type>' name line. Those are therefore the closest resolvable proxies the harness's field DSL has for 'an artifact whose key matches reingest_' and 'qa.*.disposition in {CLEAN, SOFT_FLAG}'. Deliberately carries no api_artifact.artifacts.zip criterion: _publish_artifacts (NessieAI/cc/cc_engine.py) only zips when MORE THAN ONE deliverable was produced, so a fully successful single-workbook turn (mode=new succeeds, mode=update has no D.SEQ rows to backfill) would resolve that field False even though the run worked. The 'reingest_' match on last_reply already proves a named workbook artifact was resolved -- in both the single- and multi-file case -- without depending on zip-vs-basename mechanics, so it stands in for the artifact check on its own. EXPECTED RED today regardless of the above: Checksum_PrimaryData has no path from nextseek-run-checksum into build-upload-xlsx's manifest-driven render (see this skill's SKILL.md, reingest step 3), so on a populated catalog every A.GEX/A.ALN/A.SCXP row HARD_REJECTs and 'Reingest ready' cannot appear until that wiring lands server-side.
